summary: InPoint Commercial Real Estate Income, Inc. filed a Form 8-K to furnish a stockholder letter regarding its portfolio. The letter, attached as Exhibit 99.1, was provided under Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure and is not deemed filed. No transaction, special situation, or board action is described; the filing is a routine disclosure of investor communication. The company is a REIT with preferred stock listed on the NYSE. No deal terms, prices, or recommendations are stated. The event is informational only, with no structural, financial, or strategic implications beyond regular communication. Monitoring is limited to any portfolio updates in the letter.
